lines.text: The disciples disputed over which was greatest, and Jesus said the leader should be like the one who serves.
Jesus bestowed a kingdom on the disciples, so they would eat at His altar and judge the twelve tribes.
Jesus told Simon Satan asked to sift them like wheat, and He prayed Simon's faith would not fail.
Peter said he would face prison and death with Jesus, but Jesus said he would go home to Galilee.

wrong_details.wrong: he would go home to Galilee
wrong_details.true: he would deny Jesus three times
